implementation_stages.title: Owned DAG and node identities
implementation_stages.missing: No remaining G1 gap within the declared boundary; typed payloads, entity snapshots and invocation leases belong to G2.
implementation_stages.acceptance: Both libraries: Native/Remote DAG node/edge/root queries, dependency edits, clone mapping, owner/reset/EOF cleanup and driverless clients agree.

implementation_stages.title: Typed nodes and executable snapshots
implementation_stages.missing: 44/44 API entries implemented within declared boundaries: 1D memset/D2D/H2D/D2H memcpy, kernelParams scalar/pointer/nested aggregate relocation, native attribute validation, nested child ownership, executable snapshots/update and invocation allocation/module leases. Host replay has private pinned staging, current per-invoke H2D input, aliased Host ranges and grouped completion publication. Ambiguous structural update roles conservatively reject Host-affecting setters; capture remains G3.
implementation_stages.acceptance: Both libraries: Native/replacement/preload/isolated numerical replay, current Host input, ordinary async mixing, snapshot/update/child, completion publication, allocation/module/Host leases and pending destroy; protocol/quota/failure rollback and clean resource drain.

implementation_stages.title: Capture and replay
implementation_stages.missing: No remaining G3 gap within the declared 1D memset/H2D/D2H/D2D and generic-kernel boundary. Session-owned capture DAGs track logical client threads, all three SDK modes, notifier fork/join and ADD/SET frontiers; captured Host copies reuse G2 per-invocation replay/publication. Explicit Host callback nodes are implemented in G4; 2D/3D capture is explicitly rejected.
implementation_stages.acceptance: Both libraries: Native contract differentials across modes/threads/contexts, captured operations execute nothing before invoke, inaccessible H2D input during capture, current-input numerical kernel replay, deferred D2H publication, notifier fork/join, ADD/SET dependencies, borrowed handles, raw dispatch guards, quota/reset/EOF and clean drain; replacement/preload/driverless clients.

implementation_stages.title: Client callbacks user objects and output files
implementation_stages.missing: No remaining G4 gap within the declared boundary: paired client executor, immutable Host callback identity/snapshots, per-copy Host order, native user-object refs through clone/entity/in-flight completion, client-local DOT, reentry guards and channel teardown. Runtime reentry is intentionally rejected; callbacks must return within deadline.
implementation_stages.acceptance: Both libraries: Native/replacement/preload/isolated client PID and numeric callback->H2D->D2H ordering, clone/setter/nested child, no-wait progress, unique user destructor and in-flight refs, local DOT flags/errors; Remote reentry/reset/EOF/Host retirement, protocol ownership/plan whitelist, staging rollback and submit disconnect; clean drain.

remaining.depends_on: Explicit private extension consumer and per-extension ABI contract
remaining.blocker: Installed cn_api.h declares this under Group Impl Private / @cond impl_private. remaining.next_step: Reopen only for an explicit private extension workload; specify and implement that extension ABI and lifetime instead of returning a Server pointer.

implementation_stages.acceptance: Two independently execed clients: CNRT/CNDrv device round trips and cross-library writes, CNRT Host CPU visibility, multiple importers, close-before-free, owner EOF/reset cleanup, quotas and driverless replacement/preload.
